learnings.rule: Don't list one row per car model. Roll the data up to one row per manufacturer (`mfr`), showing the mean horsepower (`hp`) and mean price (`msrp`) across that manufacturer's whole lineup — compute this with a real groupby aggregation over the raw rows, not a per-model listing.
Add a "Models" column showing how many models from that manufacturer went into each average - the reader should be able to tell a 2-model average from a 12-model one.
